title: Adobe Connect is affected by an Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an SQL Command ('SQL Injection')…
description: Adobe Connect contains a critical SQL Injection vulnerability that allows a low-privileged attacker to execute arbitrary code without user interaction. The vulnerability arises from improper neutralization of special elements in SQL commands, potentially leading to full compromise in the context of the current user. The scope of the vulnerability is changed, indicating impact beyond the initially affected component.
